required_corrections.correction: Replace the unsupported all-directories-remain-0700/only-R-or-GATE-can-mutate argument with a complete custody mechanism for target-modifiable modes/ACLs and surviving non-writable references, including queued references and future write opens. Preserve all original accepted actions/cases. Make the promised every-process-starting-unit mask coverage agree with S-F's enabled-closure inventory, and specify the stronger asynchronous/buffered-work quiescence property needed beyond serialized API dispatch. Retain UNKNOWN and the installed-premise verification requirements; do not convert any premise or finite control into an exception.

Complete and reconcile exact per-verb states/keysets and dispositions: early materialize/adopt refusals; failure or STOP after spawn permission but before CHILD_START; failed spawn reporting without a fabricated start/refusal; the release-intent timeout and late responses; verb-specific W/F success for materialize/adopt/seal-front; and Option B's RL identity message. No missing start record may imply no target, and no archival timeout may add a window-release gate.

Give one unambiguous reader/writer/export recovery rule for torn or unlinked markers and later appends: a marker cannot both end the committed chain and be bypassed by a later marker that is treated as committed. Define gaps, first-marker failures, head selection, branches and prefix cuts consistently for every consumer, preserving all raw files and forbidding failed primaries from parsed/success credit.

Define a constructible non-circular setup identity seal. setup-identities.json cannot be required to store its own final size/digest as an ordinary pinned member without a separate construction/verification rule. Bind its final bytes externally through the reviewed installed/adoption identity, or specify an equally strong non-circular scheme; preserve immutable versus intentionally mutable field checks.

Make S-R resume agree with observed poststate when a mutation completed but its done record did not: do not rerun create-only account/group/mask steps blindly. Specify complete/partial multi-object steps and their checked resume/reverse transitions. Make step.py check/write the complete log line or fail, and specify malformed/torn log handling; preserve root-reviewed staging, explicit operator choice and equality captures without a new gate. Replace the blanket sh -e pipeline-failure claim with checked producer/pipeline status handling; errexit alone does not observe every pipeline component.

Make every W/W2 backing-file identity check possible with the actual setup permissions, while preserving image custody and the same intended tree. Reconcile root-owned lost+found with the categorical W-owned-entry/name validation and growing-tree identity rules. Retain missing-mount, boot-local device observation, geometry and full executable/native compatibility requirements.

Correct v7's no-interruption-since-the-ruling claim and disclose the cited note's approximately 03:38Z timeout termination as the lead's own later interruption, without authorizing repetition or touching the D1 review. Reconcile the backup observation roster (including the naturally completed watcher) and carry its service-success/SCOPE-INCOMPLETE distinction; preserve Codex recovery ownership, offline/health limitations and the separate recovery decision. Qualify the S-1 statement that margin keeps shrinking as variable historical pressure, including the disclosed unattributed rebound, rather than a monotone trend or bound.

1.question: Closure of every v6 required correction, remaining prior correction, section-3 gap and W-1 sub-gap
1.conclusion: NOT_READY; complete specification is the closure bar; installed execution is deferred without granting acceptance

correction_rulings.text: “Each binds nothing that does not yet exist.” Materialize/dispatch pin schemas, D14 streams-before-intent and W-owned adoption destination repair old conflicts. Early refusal, failed-spawn/STOP, release-timeout, Option B RL and per-verb success rules still conflict or are missing; see R2.

“the chain stays linked across writers” conflicts with “raw evidence and ends the chain” when a later writer skips a torn marker. Allocation/slots, consumer precedence, final export ACL values and finite cuts are substantive repairs, but R3 blocks complete recovery/export closure.

“a quiescent state is absorbing” relies on all partition directories being 0700 despite target ownership and permitted ordinary chmod. A temporary lease on current writable descriptions leaves future access through non-writable retained references unclosed. Exact mask coverage and sufficient asynchronous-work quiescence remain to be specified/verified; R1.

“Nothing else is a condition. In particular the durability of a record ... is not.” The authority correction is explicit, including timeout release without a committed intent. B.4.4 nevertheless requires RELEASE_INTENT_RESULT before RELEASE_DONE and has no timeout/late-response transition; R2. This is a coherence gap, not a new approval requirement.

“No automatic undo is claimed; reconciliation S-R.” absent.py, explicit probe operands/errnos, headed ACL restore and mutable-field classification repair old conflicts. Resume from the first step without done can repeat an already completed create-only mutation; step.py discards its short-write result; setup-identities.json self-pinning is undefined. R4/R5.

“Every writer mutation lies in T.” The records image is now inside runs/records, fixing the old second-tree conflict. W/W2 must lstat a root-only backing-file path, and categorical entry validation conflicts with root-owned lost+found. R6 is needed for a usable exact image branch.

“v2's two-group, direct-UID-ACL design is superseded.” The current two-user/three-group GATE route, no-ACL recipe, optional-now/setup-later boundary, complete R2 termination consequence and timed changing activity snapshot are carried. CLOSED as package-text correction, not W-1 endorsement.

“The lead has used no TaskStop or other interruption since the ruling.” The prohibition, isolation rule and historical TaskStops are now disclosed, but that claim contradicts the cited note's later approximately 03:38Z timeout termination. The absence of another TaskStop does not prove absence of all interruptions. R7.
“CLOSED-AT-SPEC-LEVEL with those three” is expressly an author claim. Generation/channel, terminal-custody and image-observation conflicts above keep this parent correction open.

“CLOSED-AT-SPEC-LEVEL” remains unsupported by coherent self-seal and resumable fail-stop templates. Improved absence, prestate and probes do not settle the complete installation/reconciliation specification.

“CLOSED-AT-SPEC-LEVEL” remains an author assessment. The end-of-chain/continuation conflict, missing release-timeout transition and interrupted-step resume leave lifecycle, reboot, rollback and later evidence interpretation incomplete.

“no allowance or stage budget changed.” Staged setup/selftest/materialize/dispatch budgets, full restore and image payload/physical-geometry distinction reproduce. Retained CLOSED specification; no established installed capacity.

“with the complete class table” and “The full semantic obligations” carry E1 C1-C11/build_guard and E2 codec/settings/hooks/key-order/failure/encoding/full-domain correspondence. Retained CLOSED operator-consequence correction; no native architecture or full-domain acceptance.

“A candidate, not shown to work”; “whole-tree du -sb difference”; retained-reading time versus mtime. The corrected provenance and candidate status are preserved; source hashes and JACKAL reproduce. Retained CLOSED.

“not closure, not executed evidence and not acceptance” and “The next sealed review rules on it” distinguish author assessments from sealed historical rulings. Retained CLOSED status-label correction; R7 still corrects the factual supervision record.

3.question: W-1 v4 capability for V5-B01/V5-B02 as specified
3.assessment: As specified, W-1 v4 cannot yet establish V5-B01 and V5-B02 together: target-owned permissions and non-writable retained references invalidate its absorbing custody argument, and protocol, journal, setup and image checks remain internally incomplete. Its protected single-tree writer routing is a plausible V5-B02 design direction, contingent on preserving successor-frame semantics and exact installed verification; no design text or author self-check supplies that evidence.
positive_findings: Generation/attempt/adoption partitions and pre-created stream identities now have coherent normal-path ordering.
Read-only immutable writer lock and complete W2 recover authority preserve runtime frame writes inside T.
Empty PAMName drop-in withdraws sd-pam exception; masks include bus; any unreadable required manager reference is UNKNOWN.
Lease scan expressly covers current writable descriptions including queued ones, subject to installed kernel premise; it is not lasting custody.
Fallback allocation descriptor, short-write/torn-slot rules and failed-record consumers are separated coherently.
Export ACL/mode readback precedes marker and finite cuts include later W2/front terminal evidence, subject to the journal continuation repair.
Durability-only window holds are withdrawn in prose; exact protocol must implement the timeout path.
absent.py distinguishes final ENOENT from unreadable/missing parents; headed ACL restore dump and comparison text are separate.
Resources are allowances; physical geometry, executability/native compatibility and setup are future verified work.

No allowlisted action needs a session bus
Sufficient manager barrier and complete buffered/asynchronous-work observation
Kernel read-lease conflict behavior for queued descriptions and mappings on installed filesystem
ENOSPC overwrite durability and installed image geometry/noexec compatibility

4.question: Criteria, ineligibility and authority

findings.finding: Both V5 criteria are verbatim in W-1 and have complete word-identical wrapped bodies in v7; original fixed-target sentence is carried. Outside-tree authority and own-inode prevention are unchanged.
Pinning alone adds no approval gate; material reference/API/ABI/policy/custody/deployment and privileged decisions retain original authority.

S-R operator reconciliation and empty-PAMName drop-in belong to existing reserved privileged setup and rollback. Exact reviewed inventory, setup capacity gate, operator choice, probes, installed review and adoption precede dispatch.

Durability UNKNOWN expressly has no approval/release effect in prose; missing release-timeout state must be corrected to keep that ruling effective, while participant UNKNOWN and owner/token checks remain.

No tool interruption or alternate-tool guard bypass is authorized. The source-record contradiction is a required correction, not permission for a repeat. D1 recovery remains a separate operator choice; vault recovery remains Codex's.

ineligibility_preserved: Waiving warnings or changing warning policy
Reference/specification changes substituted for original acceptance
4.conclusion: Original authority preserved; S-R and the PAMName drop-in are reserved privileged setup/rollback, not added gates; release-timeout protocol still requires repair.

5.question: Options, consequences, tables and supervision

choices.consequences: Repair remains Codex-owned and needs verified health before any per-candidate offload/recovery comparison; non-task reclamation is the human's after ownership/inactivity checks; enforced limits require privileged setup and a preserving argument; holding work does not authorize interrupting tools; default dispatch deferral remains. Lowering reserve cannot close the unchanged target.

choices.timing: OPTIONAL IN PRINCIPLE NOW; CONCRETE PRIVILEGED SETUP LATER
choices.consequences: Two candidate users, three groups, GATE access, no-ACL recipe, one tree, bus masks and PAM-less manager are now described. S-R is existing setup/rollback authority. Code/inventory review, fresh stage capacity, operator setup, probes, installed review/adoption and fresh original dispatch gates remain required.
Preserving implementation repins are routine reviewed engineering; reference/API/policy/custody and privileged choices stay reserved.

Native representation/library custody/reference/owner-policy decisions are not selected now. Packet 13 is an untested notice-removal hypothesis, checked Ghost remains active, native full-domain codec/cost correspondences and controls remain required, and RW2 partial/design-only closures grant no implementation/proof/runtime credit.

R0 untouched; R1 terminate codex only then same-thread resume after fixed runner delay with inaccurate fixed transport label; R2 terminate runner and codex then fresh actual gpt-6.1 review. Preserve INCOMPLETE evidence, no review or closure credit.

5.facts_vs_recommendations: v7 labels its S-1 recommendation; numerical facts reproduce. 'Margin keeps shrinking' should be qualified as variable historical pressure because v7 itself records an unattributed increase; it is not a bound.
5.status_tables: Historical sealed dispositions match the reviews; author CLOSED-AT-SPEC-LEVEL is expressly not closure. Current claim of completed supervision correction remains unsupported and must be corrected before forwarding.
5.conclusion: Timing/consequences are substantially clear, but interruption history and the terminal backup-observation roster must be corrected before forwarding.

6.question: Any hidden weakening, assumptions or skipped reviews

findings.risk: The custody argument adds an unstated permission invariant: every generated directory remains R-owned 0700 and non-R/non-GATE references allow no future mutation. Ownership, ordinary chmod and ACL actions in the same design do not enforce it.
findings.disposition: Required W1-CUSTODY-CLOSURE; preserve original accepted cases rather than banning an original action to make the argument pass.

findings.risk: Serialized API dispatch is weaker than completion of all buffered/deferred work. The promised mask set also needs to match its inventory-generation rule.
findings.disposition: Required W1-CUSTODY-CLOSURE; retain all stated installed premises and UNKNOWN behavior.

findings.risk: An implementation could choose one side of conflicting protocol/journal/setup/image rules, creating undocumented exceptions or lost custody/failed-record evidence.
findings.disposition: Repair exact frozen specification and independently re-review; operator choice in principle authorizes no exception.

findings.risk: A false clean-interruption history could obscure adherence to the standing prohibition.
findings.disposition: Required PKG-V7-AUTHOR-RECORDS; no repeat or recovery interruption authorized.

6.no_other_undisclosed_choice_weakening_fo: The named storage, reference, native codec, checked-Ghost, C-API, owner-policy and review choices plainly preserve the unchanged target or label changes ineligible; source/pin/component/design reviews do not establish full Phase One acceptance.
6.conclusion: The custody invariant and conflicting specifications could smuggle assumptions or exceptions; repair and independent actual GPT-6.1 review are required without weakening the target.

w1_assessment: As specified, W-1 v4 cannot yet establish V5-B01 and V5-B02 together: target-owned permissions and non-writable retained references invalidate its absorbing custody argument, and protocol, journal, setup and image checks remain internally incomplete. Its protected single-tree writer routing is a plausible V5-B02 design direction, contingent on preserving successor-frame semantics and exact installed verification; no design text or author self-check supplies that evidence.
